v1p.time_basis: sum over epochs of train.epochs[].seconds (src/trackd_wm/train.py): from the start of the epoch's training loop to the CUDA synchronisation after its last step; excludes checkpoint writing, process start-up and all evaluation (WMNet training runs no in-loop validation)

v2.time_basis: sum over epochs of train.epochs[].seconds (src/trackd_wm/train.py): from the start of the epoch's training loop to the CUDA synchronisation after its last step; excludes checkpoint writing, process start-up and all evaluation (WMNet training runs no in-loop validation)

v3.time_basis: sum over epochs of train.epochs[].seconds (src/trackd_wm/train.py): from the start of the epoch's training loop to the CUDA synchronisation after its last step; excludes checkpoint writing, process start-up and all evaluation (WMNet training runs no in-loop validation)

mbrs.time_basis: phase 1 (pilot G3): sum of g3.json epoch_seconds (src/trackd_wm/pilot.py epoch_seconds), the wall time from the run-start marker to the last checkpoint, which includes the baseline's own per-epoch validation and checkpoint writing; phase 2 (I-5 continuation): train.wall_seconds (src/trackd_wm/i5.py), the wall time of the baseline's training subprocess, which additionally includes interpreter start-up and loading of the epoch-20 checkpoint; the I-5 test-split evaluation starts after it and is excluded from both phases
mbrs.validity: preliminary: single seed (0); 120 epochs (20 pilot + 100 continued); discriminator re-initialised at epoch 20 and optimiser state not restored (MBRS's own continuation restores none); about 74 times the parameters of WMNet
mbrs.continuation: discriminator re-initialised at epoch 20 (pilot archive holds no D_*.pth); optimiser state not restored (MBRS's own train_continue restores none); batch 16, lr 1e-3, noise Combined([JpegMask(50),Jpeg(50),Identity()])

hidden.time_basis: phase 1 (pilot G3): sum of g3.json epoch_seconds (src/trackd_wm/pilot.py epoch_seconds), the wall time from the run-start marker to the last checkpoint, which includes the baseline's own per-epoch validation and checkpoint writing; phase 2 (I-5 continuation): train.wall_seconds (src/trackd_wm/i5.py), the wall time of the baseline's training subprocess, which additionally includes interpreter start-up and loading of the epoch-20 checkpoint; the I-5 test-split evaluation starts after it and is excluded from both phases
hidden.validity: preliminary: single seed (0); 120 epochs (20 pilot + 100 continued with HiDDeN's own continue command; models, optimisers and discriminator restored)
hidden.continuation: HiDDeN's own `continue` command: encoder-decoder, discriminator and both optimisers restored; batch 32
